sources.name: GCAT Active / Current Catalog
sources.roleZh: 当前在轨资产、类型、轨道与运营者
sources.roleEn: Current orbital assets, type, orbit and operator
sources.coverageZh: 16,870 个活跃载荷；质量字段覆盖 100%
sources.noteZh: 已兼容 1.8.8 的 DryMass / LaunchMass 字段；快照日期与上游更新时间分开保存。
sources.noteEn: Compatible with GCAT 1.8.8 DryMass / LaunchMass fields; snapshot and upstream update times are stored separately.

sources.name: GCAT SATCAT / LaunchLog
sources.roleZh: 2000 年以来发射、在轨库存与交付历史
sources.roleEn: Launch, inventory and delivery history since 2000
sources.noteZh: 历史为 SATCAT＋SATCAT100K（不含辅助/临时目录）；含活跃与失效载荷。年内累计与全年分开，同期比较排除日期不完整的对象。
sources.noteEn: SATCAT + SATCAT100K, excluding auxiliary/temporary catalogs; active and inactive payloads. Partial/full years are separate, and matched periods exclude imprecise dates.

sources.name: Launch Library 2
sources.roleZh: 近期轨道任务、发射台、未来清单与一级复用记录
sources.roleEn: Recent orbital missions, pads, manifest and reusable-stage records
sources.noteZh: 未来日期保留 LL2 精度；详细模式的一级序列号与回收字段从 2026 年开始完整积累。
sources.noteEn: Future dates retain LL2 precision; detailed stage serial and landing fields accumulate comprehensively from 2026.

sources.name: NASA / CNSA / CMSE / provider releases
sources.roleZh: 地月、空间站、制造披露与研发飞行状态
sources.roleEn: Cislunar, stations, manufacturing disclosures and development status
sources.coverageZh: 3 个地月资产、2 个空间站、3 个研发项目
sources.coverageEn: 3 cislunar assets, 2 stations and 3 development programs
sources.noteZh: 手工核验的状态数据；每条记录保留原始发布者链接，不生成伪时序。
sources.noteEn: Manually verified state data; every record retains its publisher link and no synthetic time series is created.

sources.name: Next Spaceflight
sources.roleZh: 产品结构参考：任务清单、台址清单、复用载具卡片
sources.roleEn: Product reference: manifests, pad manifests and reusable-vehicle cards
sources.coverageZh: 不摄取数据；公开 API 仍处于征集反馈阶段
sources.coverageEn: No data ingestion; its public API remains at the feedback-gathering stage
sources.noteZh: 只借鉴信息架构，生产数据继续来自 GCAT、LL2 与官方任务来源。
sources.noteEn: Used only for information architecture; production data remains sourced from GCAT, LL2 and official mission sources.
